tt_provider: Choose where the model runs. Local for offline work, cloud for hosted models.
tt_model: Choose which model to use. If the list is empty, refresh it or check the provider account.
tt_refresh: Reload the model list. Use after adding a new model or API key.
tt_rate_limit: Pause between requests in milliseconds. Increase for free providers that return 429 errors.
tt_keep_alive: How long Ollama keeps the model in memory. Example: 5m.
tt_debug: Show detailed logs in the console.
tt_config: Settings received from the Loader node.
tt_image: Image or batch to analyze. Leave disconnected to generate from Prompt field.
tt_preset: Ready-made setup for a common task.
tt_agent: Agent mode for Optic Scanner. Controls how the model interprets the image.
tt_custom_style: Custom style text. Overrides photo/art/nsfw preset styles.
tt_prompt: Main instruction or source idea. With image: tell the model what to focus on.
tt_neg_prompt: What to avoid in the answer.
tt_lang: Language of the answer. Auto replies in the language of your prompt.
tt_detail: How detailed the answer should be.
tt_seed_standalone: Seed value. -1 = random, any number = fixed seed.
tt_seed: Shared seed value from the Seed node.
tt_model_type: Target image-generation model — adjusts prompt syntax, length, and format.
tt_prompt_mode: Auto picks Hybrid or Two-Stage depending on whether a style is selected.
tt_photo_style: Photographic style overlay applied on top of the base description.
tt_nsfw_photo_style: Adult-only photographic style overlay (alternative to Photo style).
tt_art_style: Art style overlay applied on top of the base description.
tt_nsfw_art_style: Adult-only art style overlay (alternative to Art style).
tt_temperature: Sampling temperature — higher is more creative, lower is more deterministic.
tt_max_tokens: Maximum tokens in the LLM response.
tt_provider_max_tokens: Maximum tokens in the response. 0 = provider default (no explicit limit).
tt_response_format: Ask the model to respond as plain text or as a JSON object.
tt_width: Target image width in pixels. Helps tailor prompt composition to aspect ratio if > 0.
tt_height: Target image height in pixels. Helps tailor prompt composition to aspect ratio if > 0.
tt_switch_input: Any incoming data signal (Image, Latent, Model, String, etc.).
tt_switch_enable: ON (True) passes the input signal through. OFF (False) blocks the signal.
tt_max_image_side: Images are downscaled so their longest side does not exceed this value.
tt_provider_seed: Provider-side generation seed, if supported. -1 lets the provider pick one.
scn_seed_auto_random: Auto-random — a new seed is generated each run
scn_seed_mode_tt: Random generates a new seed each run.
scn_seed_use_last_tt: Reuse the seed from the last executed run.
scn_seed_new_fixed_tt: Generate a new random fixed seed.
scn_field_linked: 🔗 Text comes from the connected node
scn_field_linked_tt: Driven by the connected input — disconnect it to type here.
sd_mode: Random generates a new seed each run.
sd_use_last: Reuse the seed from the last executed run.
sd_new_fixed: Generate a new random fixed seed.
utc_image: Input image to analyze. Optional if latent is connected instead — at least one of image/latent is required; source dimensions come from whichever is connected.
utc_upscale_model: Optional ESRGAN-style model. When connected, the image output is actually upscaled through it (then resized to the tile-aligned target). When left unconnected, image is passed through unchanged and this node is calculator-only.
upl_image: Input image to upscale. Optional if latent is connected instead — at least one of image/latent is required.
upl_model: ESRGAN-style upscale model. Only applies when image is connected — has no effect in latent-only mode.
utc_tile_size: Base tile size in pixels for tiled upscale.
utc_overlap: Tile overlap in pixels. Higher = fewer seams, more VRAM.
utc_latent: Optional latent to resize/tile alongside (or instead of) the image. When connected, the latent output is resized (bislerp) to the tile-aligned target and latent_tiles gets one crop per tile. Can stand in for image entirely — at least one of image/latent is required.
utc_auto_overlap: Ignore tile_overlap and derive it automatically from the tile size (~12.5%, min 32px) instead — keeps overlap proportional when you change tile_size. No effect when Full Auto is on (it already derives its own overlap).
utc_auto_mode: Full Auto: automatically choose tile settings based on profile.
utc_manual_cols: Force this many tile columns. 0 = compute from tile size.
utc_manual_rows: Force this many tile rows. 0 = compute from tile size.
utc_non_square: Enable non-square tiles with aspect-ratio awareness.
utc_auto_fix_edges: In Manual Tiles mode, shrink tile_size to the next standard size (1536/1024/768 → 512) instead of just warning when the grid would leave a thin edge tile. At 512 (smallest standard) it can't shrink further — the thin edge is then handled downstream by overlap/mask_blur. Does not affect an explicit manual column/row grid.
utc_out_image: Actually upscaled when upscale_model is connected, otherwise the input image passed through unchanged.
utc_out_tiles: Batch of the actual cropped tile pieces (requires show_tile_previews; edge tiles zero-padded to a common size).
ks_eta: Noise multiplier for ancestral/SDE samplers (1.0 = standard, 0.0 = deterministic).
ks_bongmath: Enable bongmath implicit correction for RES4LYF samplers (ignored by standard samplers).
ks_preview: How the live sampling preview is rendered.
ks_vae_decode: Decode the result to an IMAGE preview/output. Needs a VAE.
ks_vae: VAE for decoding the preview/output image.
ks_script: Optional FiL HighRes-fix script to run after sampling.
hrf_upscale_type: Upscale in latent space, pixel space, or both.
hrf_ckpt: Checkpoint for the hires pass. '(use same)' reuses the base model.
hrf_same_seed: Reuse the sampler's seed for the hires pass.
hrf_denoise: Denoise strength for the hires re-sample.
hrf_iterations: How many upscale+resample passes to run.
hrf_cn_preproc: Preprocess the ControlNet hint image. 'none' feeds the raw upscaled image (right for tile ControlNets).
hrf_seed_auto_random: Auto-random — a new hires seed is generated each run
hrf_seed_mode_tt: Random generates a new hires seed each run.
hrf_seed_use_last_tt: Reuse the hires seed from the last executed run.
hrf_seed_use_last_prefix: Reuse the last run's hires seed:
hrf_seed_new_fixed_tt: Generate a new random fixed hires seed.
hrf_use_cn: Guide the hires pass with a ControlNet. Tile ControlNets work without a preprocessor.
hrf_script: Optional upstream FiL script to extend.
nsc_rng_source: Device the initial noise is drawn on. 'gpu' can better match Automatic1111-style noise for the same seed.
nsc_add_seed_noise: Blend in noise from a second seed for a controlled variation.
nsc_seed: Variation seed (used when Variation is ON).
nsc_weight: Variation strength: 0 = base seed only, 1 = variation seed only.
nsc_script: Optional upstream FiL script to extend.
tla_tiles: Batch of processed tile images — same order/count as the `tiles` output that produced `layout`.
tla_layout: Tile layout from FiL Upscaler Advanced/Simple's `layout` output.
tt_cw_method: Correction algorithm. Full Auto = Gray World white balance + LAB contrast enhancement.
tt_cw_strength: Overall correction strength. 0 = no change, 1 = full correction.
tt_cw_saturate: Percentile saturation for Channel Stretch (only used by that method).
tt_cw_preserve_skin: Preserve skin tones — prevents white balance from grey-washing faces.
tt_cw_reference: Reference image whose colour distribution to match.
tt_cw_wb_mask: Mask of a neutral-grey area to sample for white balance.
sm_fusion_tt: Fast Stack just weights the descriptions. Smart Fusion asks the Vision LLM to synthesize one prompt.
